_comment: Roll-up of the tag-driven NPC mirror: every PixelLab character tagged NPC, keyed by its npcs/<folder>. The tag is the ground truth — sync.py prunes untagged folders. `name` is PixelLab prompt junk; authored facts belong in characters2/metadata.json under the same folder key.
